tldr: Pluto through the 8th house intensifies shared money, trust, intimacy, dependency, and control.
body:
When Pluto moves through your 8th house, it brings pressure to shared money, debt, trust, intimacy, dependency, fear, grief, and what is hard to control. You may notice where trust, money, attachment, or vulnerability is carrying more weight than usual.

Something may no longer stay buried, controlled, avoided, or handled only on the surface. It can help you face the deeper truth and stop spending energy protecting a false version of peace.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for getting honest about what is shared, owed, feared, or avoided.

The caution: Watch for trying to control the outcome so tightly that you cannot tell what is changing naturally. The risk is trying to control what actually needs a clearer agreement or a more truthful conversation.

Pluto moves through this house for a long chapter. Work with the deeper truth instead of forcing everything back into the old shape.
